description: Dual Wireless Connectivity Modes: Portronics Bubble 2.0 is an advanced wireless keyboard that offers seamless connectivity with both - Bluetooth 5.3 and 2.4 GHz Wireless USB Receiver, with no lagging up to 10 metres of range. Triple Device Pairing: Pair the wireless keyboard with up to 3 devices simultaneously, one using the 2.4 GHz USB receiver, and two using Bluetooth 5.3. Improve your work efficiency by easily switching between your devices. Compatibility: Compatible with Windows, Android, iOS, and macOS operating systems, and works seamlessly with devices such as PC, Laptop, Smartphone, and Tablet. It is a must-have when it comes to computer accessories. Ultra Compact TKL Design: Bubble 2.0 wireless keyboard comes in a tenkeyless compact and sleek design, to maximize desk space for easy use. It is easy to carry and use anywhere, be it- at home, office, or while commuting. Shortcut Keys: Equipped with Multimedia Hotkeys, located on the top row of the bluetooth keyboard. These keys provide shortcut access to multimedia functions and other controls, like- mute, pause, volume control, and more.
